name: Fullerton College Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: Take free college classes while in school. Classes are online, after school, or part of your high school day. They are taught by Fullerton College teachers.
who_can_apply: You must go to a partner school. The districts are Anaheim, Brea Olinda, Fullerton and Placentia-Yorba Linda. You need permission from a parent and your school.
pay_detail: Classes, books and materials are free for high school students.
duration: By semester. Up to 15 units in fall or spring.
deadline_text: The Spring 2027 form is posted as of Nov 2, 2026. The page lists no due date. The college says to apply early.
how_to_apply: Talk to your counselor first so you get on your school's list. Apply to the college with a personal email. Fill out the Spring 2027 course form. Your parent sends the authorization form one time. The college then signs you up.
notes: Not at a partner school? Ask about Special Admit, a separate program where you pay some fees and buy books. Log in to Canvas on the first day or you may be dropped. Grades stay on your college record. Questions: dualenrollment@fullcoll.edu or (714) 992-7727.
